# transfer_contract — frozen desktop<->mobile wire fixtures

Identical copies live in txtCaster (apps/desktop/src-tauri/tests/fixtures/transfer_contract)
and cast-client (src-tauri/tests/fixtures/transfer_contract). Each repo's
transfer_contract_pins test parses every file with its real protocol code and
checks SHA256SUMS. Change a fixture in BOTH repos in the same change, or the
other side's test fails — that failure is the point.

Golden instances: m1 QR payload, m2 pair response, m3 library index,
m4 manifest, m5 ranged file response. Negatives: neg_b1..neg_b6 (fingerprint
mismatch, consumed-secret replay, protocol version, interrupted+resumed
transfer, chunk integrity, duplicate delivery). source.json describes the
deterministic audio bytes every hash derives from. Generated by
make_fixtures.py (deterministic); never hand-edit.
